messages:
Mira: quick heads-up, running a targeted parse-safety sweep for raven-liteq int4 focusing on funcall JSON in streaming mode.
Arjun: what's the test matrix?
Mira: int4/int8, temps 0/0.3, stream vs non-stream, batch 1/4, 1k real prompts + 150 long-arg synthetic.
bench-bot: started job 1807001234-A on canary-pool
Javi: schema-coverage-checker v0.3 logging parse_failure_class and chunk-boundary fingerprints.
Mira: early numbers: int8 stream parse_success 96.9%, int4 stream 77.4%. non-stream int4 ~89%.
Tess: huge stream delta; examples?
Mira: lots of mid-string splits causing unbalanced quotes. sample:
```
{"tool_call": {"name":"attach_log","args":"{\"path\":\"/var/log/app.log\",\"note\":\"on save\"}"}}
```
Arjun: seems like chunk flush policy + token-prob changes from quantization.
Mira: tried cheap server-side mitigations: coalesce-midstring and conservative-flush (64-byte lookahead).
bench-bot: job 1807001234-B (conservative-flush) finished
Mira: conservative-flush bumped int4 stream to 91.0% but p95 latency +140ms. fallback-to-nonstream ~1.1%.
Javi: also seeing trailing-comma class in int4 non-stream (~0.3%). filed RW-7991.
Tess: propose gating conservative-flush behind opt-in and adding Console knob for "parse safety".
Mira: agreed. next: nightly sweep + int4 kernel pad calibration, expand long-arg set.
file_notes: canary sweep summary: streaming frag + mitigation results
